Read Pre-Phased VCF

Source: R/haplotypes.R
read_phased_vcf.Rd

Read Pre-Phased VCF

Usage

read_phased_vcf(vcf_file, min_maf = 0, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

vcf_file

Path to phased VCF or VCF.gz with 0|1 GT fields.

min_maf

Minimum MAF. Default 0.0.

verbose

Logical. Default TRUE.

Value

List: hap1, hap2 (SNPs x individuals, 0/1), dosage (0/1/2), snp_info, sample_ids.
